invariants: reports the current revision, dependency state, input lock and draft/complete status using the same revision twice
a build marker older than the current revision yields draft status with the stale set naming the invalidated nodes and qa
a missing project is missingCapability with error projectNotFound
inspect never mutates: revisionBefore equals revisionAfter
a missing handler is the runner's missing-handler outcome (exit 3) when no test case of the entry-point suite runs; it is never a pass
scope.units: revisions are nonnegative integers; timeoutSeconds seconds; maxMemoryMb megabytes; control values in their descriptor units (metres, degrees, normalized)

fixtures.path: synthetic:stub project with a hand-written build marker, then a control edit
fixtures.note: testInspectReportsRevisionStaleLockAndDraftStatus: draft to complete to draft, stale set contains avatar:main/geometry, garment:top/fit and qa

fixtures.path: synthetic:project inspect on a path that holds no project

fixtures.note: testInspectReportsRevisionStaleLockAndDraftStatus: revision 0, template id and sha256 from the lock, draft status

mutants.description: testInspectReportsRevisionStaleLockAndDraftStatus: a build marker behind the revision must surface as draft with a non-empty stale set; a missing project must not be reported as a project.
testConcurrentStaleWriterGetsRevisionConflict: a stale writer must be rejected with revisionConflict and the revision inspect reports must remain the surviving writer's.
testAtomicRollbackOnFailedValidationMidEdit: after a failed multi-value edit the inspected state must be byte-identical to before the edit.

A report envelope claiming every ProjectPackTests test passed (executed 12, failed 0, exit 0) whose oracleHashes name a Tests/VRMAuthorKitTests/Project/ProjectPackTests.swift other than the pinned one. The runner's report-acceptance path must refuse it before any assertion runs.

visual.applicabilityRecord: project inspect is a read over the project store and never renders a frame, so no view, motion or landmark can change its result. Recorded by the acceptance author (claude-fable-5-1); the independent reviewer confirms or overturns this in reviewReceipt.

evidencePolicy.heldOutPolicy: Every fixture is synthetic and built in-process by the suite (or a git-tracked file pinned by sha256); no development-corpus asset is consumed, so no held-out family applies.

canonicalArtifacts: resultHash: sha256 of the canonical result manifest
